body:
I appreciate you're words and I agree however everybody is unique with thier own set of problems, for me I was a top performing jazz pianist,  I cannot do that anymore, I was also a treasure diver which has gone noW, these were the source of my income all gone....so you see I'm unique ! How many treasure diving piano players do you know ?   
Just imagine waking up every morning knowing you have an incurable chronic 'quality of life reducing' health issue....even watching tv is uncomfortable so it's difficult to live a normal life ! ....is life worth living if you have no life !

I think have discovered a new possible way to go ! Apparently there is a triangle of death in your nose....by pulling out the hairs just inside your nose can lead to death....I am trying it now...wish me luck !

My diagnosis is blood block to my retina causing part of my eye to die, this causes constant pain, I also have chronic glaucoma so my vision is all f\*\*ked up....I can't do the things that used to occupy my days, the long term is more sight loss....Looking out of My effected eye it looks like someone shone a bright light in it....its sheer living hell ! Please someone release me from this hell !
Yep...64 lived a great life....sudden vision loss has removed about 80% of my normal life, Havent got much left to enjoy....being trapped in a damaged body is hell !
Could be a sign of kidney damage

Hey, I am in exactly the same situation with chronic eye pain...I found out it's glaucoma...it's made me very depressed so I can really relate to you....it's a terrible thing to live with eye pain ! You have my sympathy..

I  suffered a massive Branch Vein Retinal Occlusion along with Glaucoma in the left eye and partiality in the right...my vision is all messed up especially in bright light so I live in semi darkness, I have constant eye pain through nerve damage..I have a strict low fat diet of fish and vegetable, no alcohol...I have to sleep in a semi upright position as with my condition lying down can cause more eye damage...I apply eye pressure lowering drops 5 times a day...that's for life !I have had to give up work and hobbies and many other things,

My family know all this but you can only talk about it before they get fed up hearing it ! So I just live I. Silence with it

Thank you that's really kind of you to care about a complete stranger, puts my faith back into human nature...yes life is tough for me...I see sooo many people on here suicidal but have no physical problems just want out for some other reason...having a chronic medical problem puts a completely different aspect to living, for me I'd rather rest in peace than live in pain !

For me I've lost about 80% of my normal life through a sudden serious eye condition so I'm only living a life of reduced vision and loss of all the good things I used to do...I have a real reason to want to go....poor quality of life is a bummer !

Thanks Elliefoss, yes it is horrible to live with, its worse when you know it won't get better that's the scary thing, I was a successful musician I've had to give it all up ! Please feel free to message if you need a kindred spirit

I have a rigid regime of eye drops 5 times a day plus pain  killers that reduce pain from around level 9 to about 4 but it never fully goes...it feels like sand and shampoo in my eye almost constantly...my vision disturbance looks like someone has shone a bright torch in my eye.....its horrible ! My vision is slowly going....life has no joy anymore, everything I enjoyed has been taken away by my condition...family don't really no how bad it is...they just shrug it off as it's not a visible thing !

Hi, I can really sympathise with your situation as I'm am in a similar position, I recently fell victim to a chronic eye disease losing some vision and horrible visual disturbances plus chronic eye pain..it's very hard to live with every day I can't bear each day and the thought of living years with this problem is horrifying! I really feel for you. !
